event.title: Siege of Jerusalem
event.description: Jerusalem was besieged, marking the final phase of Judah's revolts against Babylon.

event.title: The Bubonic Plague
event.description: The Black Death was a plague pandemic that originated in China which then spread to Europe. It was one of the most fatal pandemics in human history, leading to the death of up to 50 million people, or 50% of Europe's 14th-century population.

event.title: Eruption of Mount St. Helens
event.description: Left a massive volcanic eruption in Washington that caused a powerful blast, landslide, and widespread destruction.
